description:
I've updated my blog-post review skill to note how much each post represents me vs AI. On a typical post it's "Claude estimates it contributed 3% of words and 10% of ideas", but when the collaboration had other aspects it tries to detail that as well. Here's what it wrote, dropping the "Claude estimates it contributed":

  • Banana Cases: "2% of words and 5% of ideas."

  • Piercing My Ear for the Whispering Earring: "4% of words and 15% of ideas."

  • Apartment Price Map v3: "13% of words and 50% of ideas; it also proposed
title: AI Usage Transparency
